text: Cute floating island, a tomato plot, a bunny-ish character. Day 2, 10 coins, Lv1. Hint says tap the ripe crop - doing that.
Tapped Momo - adorable close-up. Panel says Momo, Free time, Assign. Hint overlaps the panel text a bit. Tomatoes already ripe again. Tapping pencil.

Assigned Momo to the farm (1/4 tiles). Now a wall of text about building farm/mine/lumberyard/lab on empty tiles and demolishing. The left empty tile is highlighted. Hitting Got it then I'll try building on the empty tile.
Bought my first sea tile for 25 - the island grew with a new tree tile, +13 EXP. Satisfying. Mail bubble over Momo and red dot on Mailbox - checking mail.

Letter from Momo - charming. Odd: the list said 'What if we widened the field?' but the letter that opened is 'Maybe we could water less often'. Did I open a different one? Pressing Let's research it.
Ah, a new letter arrived and slid in on top right as I tapped, so I opened the wrong one. Reached Lv2. Opening the 'widened the field' letter.
Research tree with tabs Farm/Lumber/Mine/Smelting/Power/Games... Field expansion costs 3 flasks + 20 and needs a research lab. So I need to build a lab. Closing and tapping an empty grass tile.
Building a research lab (0) on the left tile - ghost blueprint, 4 sec build. 'Research lab 0/1' at bottom, probably 0 of 1 workers? Waiting for it.
Tapping Experiment sent Momo walking over to the lab - nice, she does the work. Lab 1/1. Income dipped a bit. Waiting to see if flasks pile up.

Started Field expansion research (29s). But my only Momo is now stuck at the lab and the tomatoes are ripe and nobody is harvesting - income falling 52->44/min. I want a second Momo. Checking mail, then I'll look for how to get more Momos.
Status screen gives a clear goal: become a City - Land 5/9, Momo 1/3, Research levels 1/3, Value 160/1.5K. Love having a target. Now: how do I get Momo #2? Checking the Life and Store tabs.
Field expansion Lv1 done! Watering efficiency is 1m30s, but Field expansion Lv2 is only 45s - going for the faster one to push research levels toward City.
Special = landmarks (Clock Tower Lv5, School Lv4, Momo Monument Lv6) - all locked. Going back to build a second farm here for 0, then buy more land.
Lumberyard going up on the front tile. Crops pay +8 now thanks to field expansion - nice visible payoff. Research done again, picking the next.
Tapping Fell made Momo walk over and chop - so the action buttons are how I direct her. She juggles farm/lab/lumberyard by herself. Now I want more land (5/9) - trying the sea next to the island.
Bought a second land tile (5), island is shaping up. Price went 25 -> 35. Still only one Momo and no idea how to get more - peeking at the Shop button.
There it is! Shop -> Hire Momo 0. Would have liked to find this sooner - the generic 'Shop' label made me assume it was an IAP store. Hiring now.
Hired Mochi! Gave her the lab (1) and lumberyard (2) - numbered route markers are a neat touch. Momo has a '...' bubble over her head, curious. Confirming and starting the next research.
City checklist: research 3/3 done, Momo 2/3, land 6/9, value 530/1.5K. Income up to 114/min. Going to hire a third Momo next.
Third Momo, Pomu, for 0 (price climbs 50 -> 80). Three bunnies on the island now - so cute together. Assigning Pomu to the farm, then spending the rest on land.
Oops, my tap meant for the sea landed on the Assign button - the Momo panel covers the bottom of the island. Tapping the farm so Pomu stays there.
Land 7/9 and hit Lv4 (School unlocks?). Island filling in nicely. Trying to grab one more tile on the right before time runs out.
Land 8/9 now. Island goes off the right edge of the screen - I'd want to pan/zoom. One more tile and value toward 1.5K and I could become a City. Out of time though - would happily keep going.
Final check: Momo 3/3 and research 4/3 ticked, land 8/9, value 792/1.5K. Close to City. Good ten minutes.
